narrative.title: The Battery Cell Baseline Scan
narrative.scenario: A battery pack logs cell voltages in a row, and the diagnostics tool must report, for each cell, the nearest cell to its left that read strictly lower — the baseline that cell is measured against. Cells with no weaker predecessor get a sentinel of -1.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array arr of cell readings.
narrative.outputFormat: Return an array where entry i is the nearest strictly smaller value to the left of arr[i], or -1 if none exists.

testCases.explanation: Nothing sits left of 1; both 6 and 2 look back to the 1 as their nearest smaller value.
A strictly decreasing row never finds a smaller value to its left.

hintLevels: Level 1: It is the mirror image of next-greater: sweep forward instead of backward.
Level 2: Pop while the stack top is >= current; whatever survives is strictly smaller and nearest.
Level 3: The stack stays strictly increasing, so after any pop the remaining bottom is always a valid smaller candidate.
